scripts.dev: bun run build && concurrently --kill-others --names package,example "bun run --cwd packages/lightbox build --watch --no-clean" "vite examples/vanilla"
scripts.build:example: bun run build && bun run --cwd examples/vanilla build
scripts.build:frameworks: bun run build && bun run --cwd examples/frameworks build
scripts.lint:all: bun run lint && bun run lint:typecheck
scripts.test:ssr: bun run build && bun run scripts/check-ssr.ts
scripts.test:bundle: bun run build && bun run scripts/check-bundles.ts
scripts.test:browser:visual: bun run build && playwright test --grep "visually stable" --project=chromium --project=firefox --project=pixel-7
scripts.test:browser:baseline: bun run build && BASELINE_CAPTURE=1 playwright test tests/browser/baseline.spec.ts --workers=1
